- **Frogeye_leaf_spot**: More distinct circular lesions with dark borders — doesn't match
- **Septoria_brown_spot**: Dark brown dots on yellowing leaves — doesn't match
- **Downy_mildew**: More irregular larger pale patches — partially similar but less accurate

The test image shows small, scattered pale yellow-green spots on an otherwise green young soybean trifoliate — this closely matches **Bacterial_Blight** early symptoms (small angular water-soaked spots turning yellowish).
